architecture_patterns.name: Three-Tier Architecture
architecture_patterns.description: Separates presentation, application and data responsibilities.

architecture_patterns.name: Microservices Architecture
architecture_patterns.description: Organizes the application into independently manageable services.

architecture_patterns.name: Event-Driven Architecture
architecture_patterns.description: Uses events and asynchronous messaging for communication between services.

selection_rules.reason: Caching, asynchronous processing and orchestration can help support high traffic.
A search engine supports indexing and efficient product searches.
Relational and document-oriented databases can support different product data requirements.
Redis can support fast cart access while PostgreSQL can persist transactional information.
Payment workflows require transactional data handling and secure communication.
Security controls help protect application access, communication and web traffic.

security_requirements.name: Web Attack Protection

security_requirements.name: Network Protection

security_requirements.name: Identity and Access Management
security_requirements.description: Authenticate users and control access to application resources.

security_requirements.name: Secure Communication
security_requirements.description: Protect data while it is transmitted between users, APIs and services.

security_requirements.name: Data Protection
security_requirements.description: Protect sensitive and stored application data from unauthorized access.

security_requirements.name: Security Event Monitoring
security_requirements.description: Monitor suspicious activities, security events and possible intrusions.
